{{Quote|Prior to this incident, the 501st Imperial Legion received orders to contain Trandoshan violence against Imperial settlers who had received the Emperor's blessing to claim the Doshan colony world as their own.|''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />}}
'''Doshan''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Drannik sector/Legends|Drannik sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Doshan blood worm]]s. A raider from Doshan once injured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Chief sergeant|Chief Sergeant]] [[Saens Sukko]] during a mission to [[Collapse of the Clowse Glowstack|collapse]] the [[Clowse Glowstack]] structure as part of the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict. Later, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] attacked Imperial [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] on Doshan. In response, the Empire's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] carried out an operation on the world, including an [[Battle on Doshan|attack]] against a Trandoshan nest near the [[Arakka]] [[Water/Legends|waterway]]. Doshan eventually became a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The 501st secured key flashpoints across the equatorial Doshan landmass.|''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />}}
Doshan was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="ImperialHandbook" /> located in the [[Doshan system/Legends|Doshan system]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Drannik sector/Legends|Drannik sector]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> Its surface featured an equatorial landmass.<ref name="ImperialHandbook" /> The world was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creatures known as [[Doshan blood worm]]s,<ref name="Destiny" /> and [[Algae/Legends|algae]] mats were present in the [[Arakka]] [[Water/Legends|waterway]].<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />

==History==
{{Quote|Chief Sergeant Sukko was among those who scaled Mittoblade's magnetic cliff, where he helped trigger the collapse of the Clowse Glowstack despite losing both legs to a Doshan raider.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
During the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> 
a raider from Doshan was present on the celestial body [[Mittoblade/Legends|Mittoblade]], the site of the [[Clowse Glowstack]] structure that was associated with the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] faction. A group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents, including [[Chief sergeant|Chief Sergeant]] [[Saens Sukko]], scaled the [[Mittoblade's magnetic cliff|magnetic cliff]] housing the Clowse Glowstack and eventually succeeded in [[Collapse of the Clowse Glowstack|collapsing]] the structure, although Sukko lost both of his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] to the raider. The Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] later noted that fact at a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

[[File:VadersFist-TSS.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Galactic Empire's 501st Legion (the unit's stormtroopers pictured in the foreground) saw action on Doshan.]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorized the settlement of Doshan by Imperial [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. Those settlers were subsequently attacked by a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]. In response, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was dispatched to the world and secured strategically important flashpoints across its equatorial landmass.<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />

In one such engagement, the [[Legion/Legends|legion's]] [[Negastrike platoon]] [[Battle on Doshan|destroyed]] a fortified Trandoshan nest at the mouth of Arakka. The [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] also [[Death/Legends|killed]] more than a hundred members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] who had opened fire from under the cover of the waterway's algae mats by [[Fire/Legends|incinerating]] the latter and consequently boiling the Trandoshans alive. The attack on the nest was later mentioned in a mission report included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] manual published<ref name="ImperialHandbook" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' is presented as an [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|in-universe document]] published nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Doshan fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW Doshan" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Demolishing the enemy fortification with thermal detonators and repeating blasters, the platoon soon found itself under fire from a company of Trandoshan raiders who had taken cover beneath the waterway's algae mats.|''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Empire, Doshan was home to an Imperial colony. A group of more than one hundred Trandoshan combatants also fought against the colonists there.<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Aboard Imperial transport boats, Negastrike platoon advanced against an entrenched Trandoshan nest near the mouth of the Arakka waterway.|''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />}}
Doshan was the site of the Arakka waterway, near the mouth of which an entrenched nest of Trandoshan fighters was situated at one point during the reign of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:The_Way_of_the_Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Doshan's name was first mentioned in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi''.]]
The name of Doshan was first introduced via a mention of the Doshan [[Blood/Legends|blood]] [[Worm/Legends|worm]] in the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' choose-your-own-adventure book [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi|''The Way of the Jedi'']] by [[Jake Forbes]].<ref name="Destiny" /> That name was subsequently used to refer to a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] location in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW Doshan" /> Another section of the book that would have included a mention of Doshan was cut before the work's release. That section was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Doshan [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Doshan itself, in grid square K-8.<ref name="Location" /> Doshan was ultimately described as a world by the 2014 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="ImperialHandbook" />
